extracted.name: Bridal Shower Punch
extracted.description: This gorgeous bridal shower punch is a simple and delicious sparkling pink drink made with just 2 ingredients: raspberry sorbet and lemon-lime soda.
instruction_lines: Spoon the sorbet into the bottom of a punch bowl. Slowly pour the soda over the sorbet. Use the back of a spoon to soften the sorbet until combined. Serve.
